summary: Closing event of the project “Explore Cross-border Aquatic Biodiversity – EXChAngE” was held on 10th November 2022 at Dubrovnik University, Croatia
body:
Role: Project Manager
Programme: IPA CBC Croatia–Bosnia and Herzegovina–Montenegro 2014–2020
Grant Agreement: HR-BA-ME419
Contracted by: Institute of Marine Biology, University of Montenegro
Geographical coverage: Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Montenegro

Provided project management services within EXChAngE, an EU co-funded initiative focused on exploring cross-border aquatic biodiversity in Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, and Montenegro.

My responsibilities included:

  • Project management: Managing project implementation in accordance with the Project Subsidy Contract and Partnership Agreement, ensuring alignment with contractual obligations and agreed implementation arrangements.

  • Procurement support: Preparing technical requirements and specifications for procurement documentation and tender dossiers supporting project activities.

  • Project reporting: Preparing project reports documenting implementation progress and activities in line with contractual reporting requirements.
